purpose: Reference inventory for knowledge-based Agent 3 explanations and supporting architecture research; not a legal or technical certification engine.

sources.title: Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) Version 1.2
sources.project_use: Source-backed advisory about emergency-alert message structure, fields and contextual required/optional/conditional distinctions, plus warning-information quality concerns.
sources.agent_3_use: Retrieve and cite relevant CAP sections when explaining structured warning information; distinguish missing optional instructions from confirmed CAP violations.
limitations: No automated XML/schema validation or CAP pass/fail in the approved MVP.
CAP conformance does not establish delivery, accessibility, usability, actionability or comprehension.
Do not treat an absent optional field as a mandatory-field violation.
verification_needed: Whether a UAE-specific CAP implementation profile applies.
Whether local rules add mandatory fields or channel mappings.

sources.title: ITU-T Y.3172 — Architectural framework for machine learning in future networks including IMT-2020
sources.issuing_body: International Telecommunication Union — Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T)
sources.project_use: Architectural inspiration for component organization, ML-related data flows, orchestration and isolated simulation testing.
sources.agent_3_use: Background architectural context only; not a rule for deciding alert accessibility or legal compliance.
limitations: The Recommendation does not mandate LastMile AI's exact four-agent architecture.
No claim of implementation certification or full Y.3172 compliance.
verification_needed: Which concepts are actually implemented in the MVP.
Additional real-network requirements if integration is considered in the future.

sources.title: TS FS 001 — Enabling Cell Broadcast for National Public Warning Service (UAE-Alert)
sources.issuing_body: Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (TRA), now Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA), UAE
sources.version_status: An official publicly linked version identified in Step 1 research; latest applicable edition not confirmed.
sources.project_use: UAE-specific context for emergency-alert presentation capabilities and device warning modalities.
sources.agent_3_use: Explain Cell Broadcast device-related accessibility and presentation context with careful applicability notes.
limitations: The document addresses Cell Broadcast; simulated CH01 is SMS, not Cell Broadcast.
Do not infer SMS requirements, national coverage metrics, or simulated delivery probabilities from this specification.
Cell Broadcast is not a sixth MVP channel.
verification_needed: Whether version 2.0 remains the latest applicable technical specification.
Whether newer requirements or UAE CAP-to-Cell-Broadcast mappings exist.

sources.title: UAE National Policy for Digital Accessibility
sources.issuing_body: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA), UAE
sources.project_use: Accessibility and inclusive-design guidance for simulated warning channels and the future prototype interface.
sources.agent_3_use: Cite relevant inclusion principles when explaining resident/channel barriers while using the individual's recorded usability flags, not disability labels alone.
limitations: Do not imply every policy provision automatically applies to all emergency alerts or telecommunications actors.
The synthetic 65+ dashboard group is distinct from the derived 60+ policy cohort.
WCAG-related website/app provisions do not automatically define all warning-channel requirements.
verification_needed: Which provisions apply to a particular deployed service or authority.
Applicable specialist emergency warning accessibility standards and later amendments.

sources.title: Federal Decree-Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
sources.project_use: Privacy-by-design guidance for synthetic data, purpose limitation, minimization, security, storage and review of hypothetical data sharing.
sources.agent_3_use: Explain relevant data-protection principles and flag scenario-specific privacy questions without concluding that an authority has violated the law.
limitations: Government data and certain government entities and sector-specific data are excluded or specially governed under Article 2; applicability must be assessed.
Synthetic data should not identify real people; artificial labeling alone does not establish anonymity.
No legal certification, automatic unlawful/lawful decision or claim that all emergency processing is consent-exempt.
verification_needed: Applicable executive regulations, amendments and sector-specific rules.
Legal basis, sensitive-data safeguards and cross-border conditions if real residents' data are ever used.
Whether a future implementation requires a data protection impact assessment or designated officer.

cross_source_rules: Use only five Step 1-approved core sources in this registry; optional 3GPP SMS reference is not added at this stage.
Label findings as verified-source information, documented synthetic scenario assumption, or unresolved legal/technical question.
Do not treat source citations as certification of legal compliance, CAP conformance, warning comprehension or real-world alert delivery.
Separate technical delivery, accessibility/usability, actionability, authorization and privacy analyses.
Use last approved Step 1 Master decisions when older research drafts differ.
No operational emergency alerts or real personal data in the MVP.
approval_alignment: Sirin approved Arabic canonical warning, CH01–CH05 renderings and Arabic TTS for CH03; sources and advisory-only boundaries unchanged.
source_content_language_note: Official source languages are unchanged; Arabic is the approved language of simulated warning renderings only.
